dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Welcome to Café Lutece. Here we have the most bitter coffees and the sweetest cakes, with guests astute and absurd.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the sweet stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Every bite is as sweet as a Melusine's smile.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Every customer has different tastes in coffee, and I shall satisfy them as I am able.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: But if someone were to order a coffee without a trace of bitterness, well, then, my abilities would be quite limited.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: In such circumstances, I would ask them to go to the Palais Mermonia or Salon Caritat, and speak to the first lady or gentleman they meet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the astute and the absurd...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: As you see, ours is a cafe and not a tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: There are some gentlemen here who will speak of all manner of things while resting — and I find myself wishing that they said them with the excuse of being drunk.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: I fear that what people say when sober might be even more absurd than the babblings of drunkards.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You seem like a sensible person.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: But for me, sensibility and sobriety are different concepts.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: I always welcome customers who are sensible and wish them a happy and sweet day.
